scope: design prototype only; actual browser interactions through CUA
checks: Resolved REGION shows four ordered sources with only the server development definition effective.
Deleting an override requires inline confirmation and updates REGION_LABEL to the inherited server base value.
Creating an override opens a page editor scoped to the current environment and server, and saves the new effective value.
Secret backup requires confirmation, exposes pending and failure states, and preserves the available local secret.
Removing a personal secret keeps its definition and surfaces one authorization issue with a direct repair action.
Repairing a secret clears missing-reference validation; replacing it marks a previous backup stale.
Staging preview leaves the active Development session unchanged; Apply routes missing authorization and header references to the repair list.
After repairing both staging references, Apply updates the top-bar environment and session badge together without connecting.
Invalid number focuses its input; changing to English and dark theme retains PAGE_SIZE, its invalid value and localized error.
Connection preflight stays disconnected, displays an actionable missing-reference notice and switches to validation.
Reveal displays only a labeled dummy value; restoring a removed secret from its personal backup requires confirmation and clears the issue.
Project and server tabs show scoped definitions; search has a clear empty state and retains input focus.
Developer role cannot edit shared definitions but can open a personal secret editor with shared metadata locked.
At 390 × 844 the page has no horizontal overflow, the variable table scrolls locally, and page-editor footer actions remain visible.
Nested JSON missing references expose both the missing name and its consumer; defining the missing value clears both errors.
Final desktop layout retains the existing workbench style, correct focused row, scoped table scrolling and an inline four-level resolution chain.
